shots.title: Add SQLite journal-mode fallback and override for WSL2 DrvFs and network filesystems (#553)
shots.notes: SQLite store setup now verifies WAL with a real write and falls back to TRUNCATE when WAL is unsupported, while SLOPE_JOURNAL_MODE can explicitly select supported journal modes.

shots.title: Prefix store I/O failures with resolved store path and journal-mode recovery guidance (#553)
shots.notes: SQLite open/setup failures now surface a SlopeStoreError with the resolved store path, original I/O detail, and WSL2/network filesystem recovery guidance.

shots.title: Require git repository or explicit degraded no-git mode in init/interview/start paths (#558)
shots.notes: init, interview, and start now require a git work tree unless --allow-no-git/--no-git is explicit, and ticket completion no longer emits raw git fatal output outside repositories.

shots.title: Reject or materialize the custom metaphor sentinel before interview writes config (#557)
shots.notes: The unmaterialized custom metaphor sentinel is no longer offered as an interview option, is rejected if submitted manually, and is defensively skipped by answer transformation.

conditions.description: The sprint crossed store portability, bootstrap preflight behavior, and interview metaphor validation, so verification needed both focused regressions and full CLI/core sweeps.

training.description: SQLite journal setup needs an operational probe, not only a PRAGMA round trip.
training.outcome: The store writes and deletes a probe row after selecting WAL, then falls back to TRUNCATE when the write fails.

training.description: Bootstrap commands that depend on commit evidence need an explicit git preflight.
training.outcome: init, interview, and start now fail with SLOPE-owned recovery text unless degraded no-git mode is explicitly requested.

training.description: Selector sentinel values must be materialized before config persistence or rejected before writes.
training.outcome: The custom metaphor placeholder is rejected centrally and cannot reach .slope/config.json as a saved metaphor id.

nutrition.description: `./node_modules/.bin/vitest.cmd run tests/store tests/cli/store.test.ts` passed: 4 files passed, 1 skipped, 88 passed tests and 25 skipped PG tests.

`./node_modules/.bin/tsc.cmd --noEmit` and `./node_modules/.bin/tsc.cmd` passed. `pnpm run build` remains blocked in this environment by pnpm ignored-build approval, so the local compiler binary was used for verification.
`node dist/cli/index.js review recommend` required architect review and suggested optional code review; scoped code and architecture review found no findings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: The sprint was straightforward once each issue was treated as a portability contract rather than a one-off failure.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When onboarding or bootstrap state can degrade, make the degraded mode explicit and keep the happy path tied to durable evidence.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The custom metaphor sentinel had multiple permissive paths: step options, answer validation, input validation, and answer transformation all needed the same rule.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S219 can build on cleaner bootstrap assumptions while review provenance work gets its own focused sprint.

bunker_locations: SQLite WAL can appear accepted by PRAGMA while still failing on the first write on DrvFs, 9p, or network filesystems.
No-git projects need an explicit degraded mode because roadmap and ticket completion rely on commit-backed evidence.
Metaphor selector sentinels should never share the same storage path as registered metaphor ids.
yardage_book_updates: src/store/index.ts now configures SQLite journal mode through a verified WAL probe, TRUNCATE fallback, and SLOPE_JOURNAL_MODE override.
src/store/index.ts now wraps SQLite setup failures with resolved path and filesystem-specific recovery guidance.
src/cli/git-preflight.ts centralizes git work tree checks for init, interview, and start.
src/cli/commands/ticket.ts now suppresses raw git fatal output and warns when a no-git completion cannot attach HEAD.
src/core/interview-metaphor.ts centralizes interview metaphor validation so the custom sentinel is rejected before config writes.
